title: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.28915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we study continuous-time reinforcement learning, where the state follows an unknown stochastic differential equation but only a fixed off-policy batch of discrete-time transitions is available. Standard discrete-time Q-learning becomes problematic as the sampling interval shrinks, because differences between action values vanish. Continuous-time alternatives, such as Deep Advantage Updating and martingale q-learning, preserve the action signal but jointly learn a value function and an action-dependent critic. Building on the PhiBE-Q formulation (arXiv:2606.21925), we develop a model-free PhiBE policy iteration (PhiBE-PI) framework that uses a single state-action critic while preserving the continuous-time action-ranking scale. translated_title: 基于离散时间离策略数据、具有端到端保证的无模型连续时间强化学习算法
translated_abstract: 本文研究连续时间强化学习问题，其中状态遵循一个未知的随机微分方程，但仅有固定的离策略离散时间转移数据批次可用。随着采样间隔的缩小，标准的离散时间Q学习会出现问题，因为动作值之间的差异会消失。连续时间的替代方法，如深度优势更新和鞅q学习，虽然保留了动作信号，但需要联合学习一个价值函数和一个依赖动作的评论家网络。基于PhiBE-Q公式化（arXiv:2606.21925），我们开发了一个无模型的PhiBE策略迭代（PhiBE-PI）框架，该框架仅使用单个状态-动作评论家，同时保留了连续时间的动作排序尺度。在每次迭代中，该框架直接从采样的增量中学习评论家，并利用它来改进策略。整个过程中重复使用同一数据批次，无需显式估计漂移或……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无模型的PhiBE策略迭代（PhiBE-PI）框架，仅使用单个状态-动作评论家、直接从离散时间离策略数据中学习连续时间强化学习策略，同时保留连续时间的动作排序尺度并具有端到端的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-free PhiBE policy iteration (PhiBE-PI) framework that learns continuous-time RL policies directly from discrete-time off-policy data using a single state-action critic, while preserving the continuous-time action-ranking scale with end-to-end guarantees.
